newsitem.title: GERMANY: German ind output fell avg 1.1 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: German ind output fell avg 1.1 pct in 1996.

text.p: German industrial production declined an average 1.1 percent in 1996 from the year before, the Federal Statistics Office said on Tuesday.
In 1995, industrial production rose an average 1.6 percent, the office said.

Weakness in the construction sector was the main factor behind the 1996 drop, the office said. Manufacturing output was nearly flat, showing a 0.1 percent decline, but construction output fell nearly 10 percent, it said.
Production began to show a rebound in December, however, it said. Overall production in December was 3.3 percent higher than in the year-earlier month.
